purpose: Seeds replayed by tests/fuzz/test_fuzz.py. Every bug a fuzz run finds and fixes adds its target, seed and iteration count here with the fix it belongs to; the runs are deterministic, so a seed is a reproducer.

state_runs.note: baseline; 300 mutated states per session, with and without a disk. The only finding: DISK_update shifted the -1 of DSKSYNC(-1, v) left in every state load (UBSan), patch 0102
T23b: the A600 profile (1 MiB Chip, empty clock chunk). The first run found that a state loaded into an ECS Agnus left programmed_register_accessed_h set (patch 0104)
T24c: the A1200 profile (68EC020, AGA, 2 MiB Chip, the 68020 block of P6CP, CAGA and the Denise ring in the video chunk): mutated states of 2.2 MB each

config_runs.note: found before the fix: a digit string of more than 4300 characters escaped normalize_config as a bare ValueError that named no option, and a request that was not a dict escaped as TypeError (an empty list was accepted as nothing requested); fixed in tools/generate_options.py
baseline after the fix; no defect found
